about: §35 (review 1-6): the most gas a relay may bill an operation. A quote whose settlementGas is past settlement_gas_cap(signed limits, own model) is refused (FeeFailure::SettlementGasTooHigh); nothing is signed on it. signed limits = user_op::in_band_gas_limits(estimate, deployed, inner floor) — gas the operation can never exceed; own model = fee_policy::static_limits_for(chain, deployed, inner floor) — the wallet's own gas model, x125% + 50,000; null when a contract call could not be measured (only the signed limits bound the bill). The 'recorded' cases are real relay quotes (Ethereum block 26,149,237, 2026-10-08, docs/fees.md and tests/app_fee_eth_mainnet.rs; the Gnosis native-parity case); Arc's relay publishes no settlementGas, so its quote is priced on its limits and the cap does not apply.
